candidate_relations.reason: The scar-associated abdominal-wall mass, menstrual pain, and endometrial glands with stroma establish secondary cutaneous endometriosis; abdominal wall endometrioma after cesarean section is an equivalent case-specific designation.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Postsurgical subcutaneous abdominal-wall endometriosis at a cesarean-section scar, forming an endometrioma.
